claims.source_quote_ar: وغَيْرُهُ بالرفع: صفة على محل الجار والمجرور.
claims.claim_ar: حصر الألوهية بالله وحده في عبارة «مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ» لإظهار عدم وجود إله سواه.
claims.claim_en: Exclusivizing the divinity to God alone in the phrase “you have no deity other than Him,” asserting there is no god besides Him.

claims.source_quote_ar: أَخاهُمْ واحداً منهم، وانتصابه للعطف على أرسلنا نوحا.
claims.claim_ar: استعمال «أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا» بصيغة تُبيّن أن شعيبًا واحد منهم (تفسير/توضيح بالكناية عن القرابة)، أي توكيد قربه منهم وكونه منهم.
claims.claim_en: Use of “their brother Shu‘ayb” to indicate he is one of them (an appositional clarification), stressing his closeness and belonging to the community.

claims.claim_ar: تضاد/مقابلة بلاغية بين «إِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ بِخَيْرٍ» و «إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُحِيطٍ» — إظهار التناقض بين الرخاء الظاهر وخطر وقوع العذاب الشامل.
claims.claim_en: A rhetorical antithesis between “I see you in prosperity” and “I fear for you the punishment of an all‑encompassing day” — contrasting apparent well‑being with impending, encompassing punishment.
claims.needs_review_reason: Support comes from the commentator's gloss identifying the punishment as the afterlife/encircling punishment; the explicit pairing as a rhetorical antithesis is inferential rather than directly named in the chunk.

claims.source_quote_ar: وصف اليوم بأليم من الإسناد المجازى لوقوع الألم فيه.
claims.claim_ar: وصف «اليوم» بصفات أليمة/محيطة يُعرض هنا كمجاز لوصف وقع الألم والعذاب — استخدام تصويري لِـ «يَوْمٍ مُحِيطٍ».
claims.claim_en: Figurative/metaphorical description: describing the day as painful/encompassing is a metaphorical ascription to convey the occurrence of pain and punishment — a figurative reading of “an encompassing day.”
claims.needs_review_reason: The source chunk speaks of describing the day as painful by a figurative (majaz) attribution; mapping this specifically to the phrase «يَوْمٍ مُحِيطٍ» is plausible but relies on interpretive extension.

claims.source_quote_ar: أَى أرسلنا نوحاً بأنى لكم نذير.
claims.claim_ar: تكرار صيغة الإرشاد والاعتداد بـ «إِنِّي/أَنِّي» (أبْنِ كهذا) كوسيلة تأكيدية لِمَرْسِلِ النُّذُر (تأكيد الذات والسلطة النبوية).
claims.claim_en: Repetition/formulaic self‑assertion using “Inni/Anni” (I am) as an emphatic device asserting the messenger's authority and warning role.
claims.needs_review_reason: The chunk shows the formulaic use of »أَنِّي« in prophetic speech; applying it to the specific twin occurrences of «إِنِّي» in the verse is reasonable but the source example uses a slightly different orthography/wording (أَنّي).

warnings: Source material provided is limited to Zamakhshari (al‑Kashshaf) chunks. Claims are extracted/inflected from those chunks; coverage from al‑Jurjani, al‑Sakkaki, al‑Baqillani, al‑Suyuti and tafsir‑balagha is not present and therefore not represented.

Some claims (marked with medium confidence) involve interpretive extension from commentary quotations rather than explicit naming of the exact rhetorical label in the chunk; these should be reviewed against additional tafsir/balagha sources for confirmation.
